description: Edit fields and full YAML frontmatter, reject invalid YAML, then save and reload to verify structured metadata and body persistence. Uses an isolated browser context with a v2 localStorage fixture (the legacy m3 seed is a placeholder).

actions.value:
entityType: item
slug: edit-demo
title: Updated title
createdAt: 2026-01-01
updatedAt: 2026-01-01
tags: [one, two]
custom: {reviewed: true, score: 3}
boards:
  - board: board-main
    assignee: alice
    note: keep

assertions.description: Full nested metadata and board entries survive reload; removed keys stay removed.
assertions.script: const item = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('awesome-markdown:v2'))['item:edit-demo']; if(item.custom.reviewed !== true || item.custom.score !== 3 || item.tags.join(',') !== 'one,two' || item.boards[0].note !== 'keep' || 'obsolete' in item) throw Error('Metadata roundtrip failed');

assertions.description: The title edited in fields is preserved through YAML editing.
The description stays separate from frontmatter and survives reload.
